decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission P/2372/21 dated 03/11/2022

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development herein approved
shall not commence until a Fire Safety Statement has been submitted to and approved
in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include
details of how the development will function in terms of the following:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">1) identify suitably positioned
unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b)
appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">2) is designed to incorporate
appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious
injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and
passive and active fire safety measures; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">3) is constructed in an
appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">4) provide suitable and
convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building
users; <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">5) develop a robust management
strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published
(details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published
to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in; and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">6) provide suitable access and
equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the
development.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be operated
in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;">The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with details of the details approved under approval of details application P/2139/23 dated 12/09/2023 unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained<br></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby permitted
shall not commence until evidence of consent from Thames Water for the foul
discharge connection has been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local
planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the
works so agreed and the works shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">Evidence of certification of
Secure by Design Accreditation for the development (silver of gold) shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before any
part of the development is occupied or used.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development hereby permitted
shall be constructed to the specifications of: "Part M, M4 (2), Category
2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013
and thereafter retained in that form.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The flat roof areas of the
building beyond any balconies or terraces, hereby permitted shall not be used
as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further
specific permission from the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">Other than those shown on the
approved drawings, no soil stacks, soil vent pipes, flues, ductwork or any
other pipework shall be fixed to the elevations of the buildings hereby
approved. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the provisions of
the Electronic Communications Code Regulation 5 (2003) in accordance with The
Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any
order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development
which would otherwise fall within Schedule 2, Part 16, Class A of that order
shall be carried out in relation to the development hereby permitted without
the prior written permission of the local planning authority. <o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall not
progress beyond damp proof course until details of the provision of
green/biodiverse roofs within the development have been<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">submitted to and approved by the
Local Planning Authority. The details to be<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">submitted shall comprise:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">a) identification of the roof
areas to be used for the provision of<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">green/biodiverse roofs;<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">b) details of the planting and
substrate to be used, including roof build up,<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">plant species/mix(es) schedule
which should include at least 20 native flower<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">species, plans and sections as
appropriate; and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">c) details of the maintenance
including irrigation.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">The development shall be carried
out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained and
maintained as such thereafter.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height:normal">The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with details of the Materials approved under approval of details application P/0302/23 dated 14/12/2023 unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained</span></p><p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><br></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span style="text-align: start;">The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with details of the&nbsp;</span><span style="text-align: justify;">detailed sections at metric scale 1:20 through all external reveals of the windows and doors on each of the elevations&nbsp;</span><span style="text-align: start;">approved under approval of details application P/0302/23 dated 14/12/2023 unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained</span><br></p>
description:
Removal of condition 8 (television reception equipment) attached to planning permission P/2372/21 dated 03/11/2022 for Redevelopment to provide six storey building comprising eight flats (6 x studios and 2 X 2 bed); ground floor commercial space, ground floor
rear extension; bin and cycle stores. [RECONSULTATION: Due to design revisions and change in unit numbers]
